name: simple-2d-animation-studio
description: AI-powered simple 2D animation studio: drawing, storyboard, timeline, playback, and export.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
